mods.name: Alloy Area Scanner
mods.changelog: New Alloy look: the scanner screen now matches Alloy Hub (Settings, Custom blocks and Presets tabs, block suggestions as you type, confirm before deleting a preset). Own Alloy Hub page with a Custom blocks tab. HUD follows the Alloy theme. Your settings, hotkeys, custom list and presets carry over.

mods.name: Alloy Backups
mods.changelog: CytraBackups is now Alloy Backups. Renamed from Cytra to Alloy, with the new Alloy logo. Nothing else changes: settings, commands and saved data stay the same.

mods.name: Alloy Bot Macros
mods.changelog: Cytra Bot Macros is now Alloy Bot Macros. Renamed from Cytra to Alloy, with the new Alloy logo. Macros now run for everyone by default (runPermissionLevel 0); raise it in the config to limit who can run them. Settings, commands and saved data otherwise stay the same.

mods.name: Alloy Carpet
mods.changelog:
New Alloy Carpet menu: /cytra menu, a key (unbound) or Mod Menu opens it
Switch your /cytra toggles and options, and edit your trash list (add held item, add by id, remove, clear)
On servers without Alloy Carpet it shows the client fallback settings
Needs Alloy Carpet 1.6 on the server for the toggles; /cytra still works for everyone

mods.name: Alloy Container
mods.changelog:
- New Alloy look for the storage menu (Y) and a new settings screen (L + C), in your Alloy Hub theme
- Pick block, easy place and fills now take from stacked shulker boxes (needs 1.5.0 on the server too)
- Fixed: filling a crafter sometimes left one slot empty

mods.name: Alloy Creative
mods.changelog: Cytra Creative is now Alloy Creative. Renamed from Cytra to Alloy, with the new Alloy logo. Nothing else changes: settings, commands and saved data stay the same.

mods.name: Alloy Hub
mods.changelog:
- /cytrahub <mod> opens the Hub straight on that mod's page (Tab completes the mods)
- Alloy Trades page: auto-supply settings (with Alloy Container) and the trade hall sweep key
- Changelogs for Alloy Ledger 0.4.0, Alloy Container 1.5.0 and Return Cannon Maker 1.5.0

mods.name: Alloy Ledger
mods.changelog:
/ll undo now works after a server restart
All chat text is translatable (cytraledger.* keys, English by default)

mods.name: Alloy Map
mods.changelog:
- Every screen now uses the Alloy theme (Nocturne, or the theme you pick in Alloy Hub): settings, world map toolbar and panels, right-click menu, marker editor, map worlds, Xaero import
- Settings: foldable sections, a reset button on every row and tips on hover; the world map's quick panel uses the same list
- Marker editor: full colour picker (hex, recent colours) next to the 16 quick colours
- Fixed: waypoints in the world drifting off their spot when the view zooms (sprinting, Speed, spyglass, zoom mods)

mods.name: Alloy Map
mods.changelog:
- Every screen now uses the Alloy theme (Nocturne, or the theme you pick in Alloy Hub): settings, world map toolbar and panels, right-click menu, marker editor, map worlds, Xaero import
- Settings: foldable sections, a reset button on every row and tips on hover; the world map's quick panel uses the same list
- Marker editor: full colour picker (hex, recent colours) next to the 16 quick colours
- Fixed: waypoints in the world drifting off their spot when the view zooms (sprinting, Speed, spyglass, zoom mods)

mods.name: Alloy Mass Craft
mods.changelog:
New Alloy look: the Mass Craft panel uses the Alloy theme (Nocturne, or the theme you picked in Alloy Hub)
Primary buttons are filled (Craft, Confirm), themed text boxes, progress bar and search list
Works with Alloy Container 1.4.1 (now the minimum)

mods.name: Alloy Pack Mixer
mods.changelog:
Louder themed sounds
- Themed mace and trident sounds come from Alloy Pack 1.3.2: every one at full volume, with clearer sounds per theme, so they're no longer drowned out by the vanilla mace and trident sounds
- /alloysounds shows what the themed sounds are doing (setting, whether the server has Alloy FX, sounds loaded, the last one played or why it was skipped) and plays a test sound
- debugSounds in the mixer's config.json logs every themed sound for troubleshooting

mods.name: Alloy Printer
mods.changelog:
New settings screen in the Alloy look: Printer, Accuracy, Blocks and Extras tabs
Alloy Hub page: printing switch, status, settings, quick actions and the status box position
Ops can turn the server placement helper on or off from the Hub's Server tab
Block lists are typed as one line, like stone, #minecraft:logs
Printer messages are translatable

mods.name: Alloy Send
mods.changelog: Cytra Send is now Alloy Send. Renamed from Cytra to Alloy, with the new Alloy logo. Nothing else changes: settings, commands and saved data stay the same.

mods.name: Alloy Shulker View
mods.changelog:
- New settings screen in the Alloy look: open it from Mod Menu, or bind Open settings under Controls (no key by default)
- All settings in one place: item icon, fill bar, icon sizes, label distance, named shulker textures, bar colours
- Follows the theme picked in Alloy Hub

mods.name: Alloy Sticky Toggle
mods.changelog:
Settings screen in the Alloy look (works without MaLiLib)
Alloy Hub page with every block and setting
Renamed to Alloy Sticky Toggle

mods.name: Alloy Syncmatica
mods.changelog:
- Material lists read schematic size correctly, so /cytra-syncmatica where shows the real centre and distance
- New settings screen in the Alloy look (Settings button in the material screen, openSettings hotkey)
- Chinese translation completed for everything added since 1.0

mods.name: Alloy Trades
mods.changelog:
New settings screen in the Alloy look: tool row, favourites you can reorder or remove (with a confirm), toasts
All text is now translatable
Hint when a stick is set as the trade tool while Litematica is loaded

mods.name: Alloy Waypoints
mods.changelog:
New Alloy look for the waypoint menu, routes and forms (follows your Hub theme)
Settings screen (gear in the menu, or Mod Menu): on/off, Xaero sync, Esc-menu button, default sort, remember last view, menu key
Add to Xaero, Edit, Set status, Teleport and Remove are in the ⋯ menu; Remove asks first
Server answers show as pop-ups

mods.name: Cytra Link
mods.changelog: Bots may send larger messages once connected (up to 8 MB), so areas sent to labs travel fast.

mods.name: Return Cannon Maker
mods.changelog:
- The advanced generator now uses the Alloy Nocturne look: every solution in one sortable list, with a details card
- The block palette is redone too: colour presets, block categories, search, warped/crimson wood
- Messages show as pop-up toasts in every cannon screen
- Generating from the advanced generator still opens Litematica's save dialog
